PF2ECALENDARBAR.Clock.Halted.no-active-g: Time is stopped: no GM is connected
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Clock.Halted.game-paused: Time is stopped: the game is paused
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Clock.Halted.combat: Time is stopped: an encounter is under way
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Override.Title: Today's weather
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Override.Hint: Applies to this day only. Later days go back to generated weather.
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Settings.Latitude.Name: Latitude
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Settings.Latitude.Hint: Drives how far sunrise and sunset shift across the year. 48 is central Europe; 0 gives a constant twelve-hour day.
How many units the outer double arrows move by. The inner arrows always move one.
Adds the condition and temperature to the bar.
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Settings.ClockRatio.Name: Time ratio
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Settings.ClockRatio.Hint: Game seconds per real second while the clock runs. 1 is real time; 60 makes an hour pass each minute.
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Settings.ClockTick.Name: Tick interval
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Settings.ClockTick.Hint: Real seconds between clock updates. Each update is sent to every connected client, so short intervals cost more than they look.
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Settings.PauseOnCombat.H: Encounters track their own time in rounds, so the running clock usually should not also advance.
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Settings.SceneWeatherSyn: Sets the scene's weather effect to match the day. Never overwrites weather set by hand, and skips scenes opted out in their configuration.
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Settings.CalendarFile.Hi: Path to a JSON file replacing the month and weekday names, era and year offset. Leave empty for Golarion. Requires a reload.
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Mapping.Name: Weather effects
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Mapping.Label: Configure effects
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Mapping.Title: Weather effect for each condition
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Mapping.Hint: Which scene ambience each condition applies. The list is whatever this world has registered, so effects added by other modules appear here too.
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Scene.OptOut.Name: Ignore calendar weather
PF2ECALENDARBAR.Scene.OptOut.Hint: Keeps the calendar from setting this scene's weather. Use for interiors and anywhere underground.
